ns2:course.label: Classical Modern Philosophers
ns2:course.description: Intensive study of one, or in special cases, two major philosophers of the period 1600-1900, e.g., Descartes, Hume, Kant, or Hegel. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated. Students may register in more than one section per term. Prerequisite: One course in philosophy.
